name: Stealphie
source:
Stealphie [spoiler]D. Jepsen[/spoiler] was the secretary to President Obama. With a notable like of [url=/v715]Gyakuten Saiban 2[/url] and a disapproval of horniness, she was met by [url=/c96101]Apollo Justice[/url] while he was investigating the president's murder.

[spoiler]
Though [url=/c94651]clem[/url] declared his candidacy for the presidency after his innocence was finally proven, Stealphie was running against him, and was the frontrunner in the election throughout the next few months. The likely president-elect was, however, then arrested for the murder of her former co-worker, [url=/c95768]Wynaut[/url].

Stealphie would later become the victim of a heart attack. [url=/c94650]pichuis[/url] attempted to tamper with the apparent circumstances of her death, which he believed to have been caused by smirkhuman, only being exposed during the subsequent trial for Stealphie's murder.
[/spoiler]
